items.title: Data-Driven Homepage
items.desc: 这个站本身。所有内容来自 src/data/*.json 单一事实来源，构建脚本产出纯静态 HTML —— 线上零运行时依赖、零 CDN、零字体外链，整站只有三个文件。内建发布前隐私闸门：任何可能泄露个人信息的内容都会直接阻断推送。另有单文件导出，离线双击即可打开。
items.descEn: This site itself. Everything comes from a single source of truth in src/data/*.json, and a build script turns it into plain static HTML — no runtime dependencies, no CDN, no external fonts; the whole site is three files. A privacy gate runs before every publish and blocks the push outright if anything personal slips in. There's also a single-file export you can open offline with a double-click.

items.title: Competitive Programming
items.desc: 两年 ACM 赛制训练：Codeforces 两个账号累计 67 场 rated、2749 次提交，横跨在线赛与线下全国邀请赛。主语言 C++，主攻图论、动态规划与数据结构。右边的曲线是这两个账号的真实 rating 变化。
items.descEn: Two years of ACM-style training: 67 rated contests and 2,749 submissions across two Codeforces accounts, spanning online rounds and offline national invitationals. C++ is my main language; I focus on graph theory, dynamic programming and data structures. The curve on the right is the real rating history of both accounts.
